comparison.objective: Orient and place five SMD LEDs on PCB footprints; candidate commissions a damper.
comparison.physical_skill: Tweezers handling of 5 mm parts, polarity alignment, and unregistered precision placement versus hex-key insertion, counterholding, collar tuning, and locking.
comparison.success_condition: Each LED flat, centered within 1 mm, and oriented within 10°, followed by tool stowage, versus two safe impact cycles and retained setting. No separate spec versions were provided.
comparison.reason: Precision component placement is not adjustable-device commissioning.
